# Jeff Allison

Jeff Allison is a former Hot Wheels designer who worked with Mattel from 2013 to 2014. He was mainly responsible for the creation of many of the first wave of Star Wars Character Cars. Jeff currently runs his own firm, Allison Design, as well as Old Anvil Speed Shop.
